name: Marigold
source:
"Marigold at your service. [url=/c136409]Dear guest[/url]. Please feel free to ask me for anything. I will do my best to fulfill any request within my reach. ...Oh, did I say "anything"? Yes, that's right. Anything, indeed."

Marigold, a blonde room maid in the mansion, possesses a gentle and polite personality.
She finds genuine joy in pleasing others. However, in a mansion devoid of guests, Marigold had no choice but to go about her work silently, feeling unfulfilled.

The arrival of Akira and his work has piqued Marigold's interest. Intrigued by his writing, she has begun to explore novels she wouldn't typically read.

[u][b]Akira's Memo[/b][/u]
This girl has a vibe of an [i]ojousama[/i] from a respectable family written all over her. Being a room maid, she's right there to cater to my every need. While having maids around can be nerve-wracking, her presence puts me at ease. She's all ears, ready to listen to whatever I say. But that's precisely why I need to watch my mouth and avoid inappropriate remarks...

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara01.html]official website[/url]]
